sources.dust: Production game material albedo texture, seamless square tile, top-down orthographic flat material capture filling the whole frame. Fine burnt volcanic ash and charcoal sand, dark warm brown-black powder, soft ash drifts and fine wind streaks, scattered pinhead black grit. Rich realistic microstructure and distinct medium-scale geological variation across a 4 metre patch. Dark burnt volcanic palette with readable mid-dark mineral detail rather than pure flat black. Uniform diffuse neutral lighting, no baked directional shadows, no directional highlights, no ambient vignette or gradient, no perspective, no horizon, no isolated floating objects, no vegetation, no snow, no moon craters, no text or watermark. All four edges must tile seamlessly. This is a color source for a physically based terrain material; do not render a normal map, do not include emission. 2048x2048.
